integrity: The universal statements have symbolic proofs; exact finite computations are supporting checks and not infinite certification. No independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to the m base-edge fixed points of the edge toric projective varieties of m triangles sharing one central vertex, m >= 2; no other fixed points or global singular locus determined. The class group is local. The normal Gorenstein complete intersection and its tangent cone are algebraically distinct. Originality may be limited by unknown equivalent toric specializations.
title: Exponential local divisor-class groups at base-edge fixed points of friendship-graph toric varieties
